change_summary: Distinguish source topics from user Project identity, keep long-running MCP polling compact, preserve opaque handles and explicit relationship corrections, and separate ambient Workspace selection from new unbound external-Agent write intent.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill and API reference make search-hit Workspace identity read provenance only, default new unbound writes to the writable personal Workspace, and preserve explicit or receipt-bound destinations.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-16.6 carries the unreleased 1.7.54 Work Model, compact polling and handle-integrity delta, then splits read/navigation selection from new unbound writes; Page, Project, Asset and allow-actions creation prefer personal default while explicit and object-bound routes remain authoritative.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.55; compatibility family, minimum revision, write consent and installation scope remain unchanged.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace/Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.34; an explicit CLI project or workspaces-use selection is process-local authority and remains compatible with contract 2026-09-16.6.

help_center.note: Existing public setup guidance remains compatible; exact document mechanics are projected through the changed public API guide, CLI help and focused Skill reference.

package_setup.note: SessionStart exposes release 1.7.55 and makes the unbound-write personal-default boundary visible before a Host can promote a search hit or shell selection.

harness_and_mainline.note: The cumulative mainline preserves source-subject versus user-work-subject reasoning and explicit correction authority, then records why reads retain ambient selection while new unbound writes use personal default without weakening explicit or object-owned continuity.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party 1.7.55 publication, hashes, fresh released-host loading and deployed OAuth/MCP behavior remain release receipts; external directory acceptance remains outside the repository boundary.

release_evidence.note: Cumulative evidence covers longitudinal Work Model identity and correction, compact operation payloads and fixture integrity, plus selected-Team versus personal-default routing, explicit Team preservation, write recommendation, MCP tool guidance and package freshness; fresh released-host semantic acceptance remains the live gate.
